newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telecom Argentina EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telecom Argentina EPS cut.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said on Wednesday it had cut its fiscal year 1995-96 estimate for Telecom Argentina's earnings per American Depositary Receipt (ADR) to $2.73 from $3.12.

-- Analysts Mickey Schleien and Marina Grande said, "The First Call estimate is $2.85, but recent estimates are about $2.70. Our estimate for the September quarter is $0.65, which is in line with recent estimates, but below the $0.73 consensus."
-- They said they reduced their earnings estimate in part because of continued weak demand for access lines and higher operating costs.
-- The company's ADR was off one to 38-7/8 in early trade.
